name: Caspers Eatery & Bar
title: Casper´s Café Lounge Bar: Benidorm old town open daily from 10:00 until late
description: Casper´s Café Lounge Bar  in the centre of Benidorm old town. Open all day for drinks, snacks and lunch or brunch. While away a few hours on the terraces or enjoy a good old banter at the bar. Casper´s gay bar always a warm friendly welcoming venue. The bar is open every day from 10:00 until midnight and food is served daily from 10:00 until late including great British breakfasts, burgers and fish and chips.
